notes.title: Komadori Inn at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have some thrilling news to share with all of you who loved "Long and Hard... Summer!" Our new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180930/Komadori_Inn_Demo/]Komadori Inn[/url], is participating in the ongoing Steam Next Fest, celebrating demo versions of upcoming games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/a530f7744d6372fd935a5823a13b2b7d900a54d4.png[/img]

Komadori Inn is bigger and better in every aspect compared to our previous game. It features animated scenes and other elements that many of you wished for in "LaHS!" But don't worry, we're crafting it with the same spirit, so we're confident you'll love it just as much.

In this new adventure, you'll find:

[list]
[*] [b]Expanded Story and Gameplay:[/b] With more quests, characters, and a deeper narrative, there's so much to explore and enjoy.
[*] [b]Animated Scenes:[/b] Bringing key moments to life with beautiful animations.
[*] [b]New Mechanics:[/b] Introducing fresh gameplay elements to keep things exciting and engaging.
[/list]
And much, much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/7ca8373b718d8b84c800b703d39e1c22b7e7728e.png[/img]

We can't wait for you to experience Komadori Inn and see all the improvements and new features we've been working on. Your support and feedback have been invaluable, and we hope you'll join us on this new journey.

Come and play the demo during Steam Next Fest and let us know what you think! Your thoughts and suggestions are always welcome as we continue to develop and refine the game.

[h2]Play the demo[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180930/Komadori_Inn_Demo/

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Sale, Trading Cards, DLC!
notes.content:
Howdy Horny People!

It's been a while since we've given an update on what's going on in the world of LaHS, and we've gathered some information on upcoming sales, community items, and game content updates, so let's get going!

[h1]Sale[/h1]

The Steam Spring Sale is about to start this Thursday (16.03) and will last for a week, where everyone will be able to purchase LaHS at a discounted price. This is our first sale since the game's release, and seeing how many players are anticipating it, we decided to promote it at 30%!  Don't forget to let your friends know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/db64a78b8cd7ce2e2f3d05f49aa9223cb6041050.png[/img]

[h1]Community Items[/h1]

We are extremely pleased to announce that LaHS has qualified for a group of games entitled to add Cards, Badges and Profile Backgrounds, which you will be able to acquire by playing the game and exchanging with other users. Well... the truth is that we qualified some time ago, which we also already announced, so we are extremely pleased to announce that the cards have just been launched! We're already past the rounds of Valve checking these items (yes, they're checking that they meet the Community Criteria and that we're not, for example, trying to squeeze in some nudity in somewhere), we've made a few minor adjustments and these have been approved. So you can try to get a total of 6 cards with our ladies (plus our badges, backgrounds, etc.). If you already have enough game time on your timer, the cards should add to your inventory automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/8bdaad9360a5b25d0f7ecd70d8b0c78f140ceb74.png[/img]

[h1]Content Update[/h1]

If you have been with us from the beginning, you probably know that we were planning to release a DLC. Yes, we planned, we are still planning it and still working on it. It's taking us a little longer than we expected, but that's mainly because we had to take care of a few things in our personal lives. 

Nonetheless, we are really close to finishing the work. We're left with the final touches, text translation and decent testing of the whole thing. And there is a lot to test!

In terms of important information - we stand by our promise and the update will be completely free and available to all who own a copy of LaHS. We also decided that it will not be a "DLC" existing as a separate package requiring download/installation, but simply an integral part of the game that everyone will receive automatically.

The centerpiece of the update is a maid who (for a small fee) will be able to come to the main character's apartment and keep it clean. We've taken into account your suggestions that the mechanics of getting the apartment dirty can be a nuisance, and we're happy to introduce something that will improve the enjoyment of the game.

The maid is not just any maid, of course, and she is Yukiko Hirano-chan, who we have already introduced on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/InletPipeProds]Patreon[/url].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/5b0acfd2a589d67f8d044902f93cbf61abc22539.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/6a92aaba6bfd917f1bda6903dc5a98bd69ed6b3a.png[/img][/url]

Also, you can find there illustrations of two (and soon a third) close encounters with her, which you will of course be able to get during the game. So if you can't wait for the details, please visit our [url=https://www.patreon.com/InletPipeProds]Patreon[/url] (and by the way, thank you all for your tremendous support! Soon we hope to reward you with more bonus illustrations and.... animated scenes!).

In the course of the game you will be able to learn about the dark history of Yukiko-chan. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/afa75b8ca09b743579094e98ef2e1dff7fec9313.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/0c1579f94a9200099d540b64ad541ab873ff44bc.png[/img][/url]

The key point for its development (and unlocking more scenes) will be a mini-game, but don't worry! We've taken into account all your comments regarding the two mini-games already present, and this one shouldn't be so frustrating. I don't want to give you spoilers regarding Yukiko-chan's story itself as well as the mini-game, but catch a little preview of what we have in store for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575917/b9ab208bd857de845742a6a051e93525a251e114.png[/img]

We hope you are looking forward to this update at least half as much as we are! We are very curious to see if you like what we have prepared for you.

Bye bye~!

notes.title: A little update
notes.content:
Hello Players!

It's crazy to think that it's been only a month since the game's release. It feels like so many things happened since then. Probably because we're spending additional hours refreshing every possible page, waiting for bug reports and reviews and checking numbers to be sure that the game runs smoothly and everybody's simply enjoying it.

Thanks to our excessive testing before the release, there weren't many things we needed to fix, and with the last update to version 1.03 two weeks ago (which was mostly just Spanish translation) bug reports pretty much stopped. This allowed us to reflect on the other wishes of our players and additional content that we would like to add to the game in the near future. Additionally, we promised you at least one free DLC and we want to keep that promise. Our lower activity on [url=https://discord.gg/SjfA5AWnqe]Discord [/url]and other communication channels means only one thing - we are working on it!

Something we've already shared on our Discord server some time ago, the DLC will include a minigame, 
 more than one sex scene and maids that will come and clean our house. The details are still being fleshed out, but you can read more (and see the new planned character!) on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/InletPipeProds]Patreon[/url].

Take care!

notes.title: V 1.02
notes.content:
Update 1.02 is coming sooner than expected! But with one bad news.

We had to backtrack from introducing mouse controls. :( The first tests were promising, but we encountered enough difficulties along the way that in its current state, this feature would be more trouble than fun. We may come back to this feature at some point, but I don't want to make any promises now because it turned out to be more difficult than we thought. If you've been waiting for this, we're sorry!

Thus, the list of changes looks like this:

- The PC minigame saves its state, so when you return you can pick up where you left off
- In the same minigame, the controls have changed - you don't need to press space to dash
- The last level of the same minigame is a little easier
- The nurse scene is unlockable after week 8 (Hasegawa-sensei will still be available in the classroom and will allow you to retake tests, enough to achieve an "A" grade with full knowledge)
- Dirt in the apartment rises a little slower
- Spanish translation added in beta for about 60% of the content

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Winter Sale and next patch incoming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As most of you probably already know, the big Winter Sale is about to start! Taking advantage of this opportunity, we decided to extend our release discount for the duration of this event, so "Long and Hard...Summer!" will still be available for 20% off until January 5th! Yippee!

If anyone expected a bigger discount: we could either extend the current one or not give any at all, so...

But this is not the end of news, because in a day or two (or three or four) we will post another batch of fixes made after your comments!

What will change?

- [strike] Mouse control! - this is our first attempt, so it won't be perfect and will definitely need some tweaking, but we'll be expanding this feature with future updates. Let us know if you like this control style. Currently, the mouse will only be available during gameplay (menus and phone will still require a keyboard or gamepad). [/strike]
- The PC minigame will save its state, so when you return you will pick up where you left off
- The last level of the same minigame will be a little easier
- Controls in the same minigame will change - you won't have to press space do dash anymore
- Nurse scene will be unlockable after week 8 (Hasegawa-sensei will still be available in the classroom and will allow you to retake tests, enough to achieve an "A" grade with full knowledge)
- Dirt in the apartment will grow a little slower
- Spanish translation will be added in beta for about 60% of the content

We will inform you about the release of the patch in a separate post. Now have fun!

[EDIT]
We had to backtrack from introducing mouse controls. :( The first tests were promising, but we encountered enough difficulties along the way that in its current state, this feature would be more trouble than fun. We may return to this feature someday, but I don't want to make any promises right now because it turned out to be more difficult than we thought. If you've been waiting for this, we're sorry!

notes.title: V 1.01 patch!
notes.content:
Hello horny people!

We're two and a half days into the game's release and the interest in LaHS has exceeded our wildest expectations!

A big high-five for everyone who likes our game! And for those who don't like it - thank you for your comments and tips on what we could do better. The place where we are now as IPP came only from our willingness to develop. As a small two-person studio (working with great artists), we knew from the start that we couldn't please everyone with our first Dating Sim, and collecting feedback is just a natural part of getting better at what we want to do. And comparing the reception of LaHS to our previous games, we're doing pretty well.

Today you received the first set of small tweaks that we made thanks to your feedback. Thank you again for it!

A list of changes:
- We changed the description of the "True Criminal" quest - many of you pointed out that it is not clear what needs to be done next
- Hold ESC to exit minigame on PC - accidental exit will no longer happen
- Fixed name input for Chinese version - now it is possible to enter all characters
- Akari "problem" fixed - a particular combination of events prevented the relationship with Akari from developing. And now not anymore!
- Z and X keys - for those who are used to the controls known from RPG Maker games
- Default Name - Our quick fix for Steam Deck issues where you couldn't enter your name, which prevented the game from starting. From now on, the game proposes a name for the hero, which can of course be changed. This isn't our last word on the subject, but we don't have access to the device so it's hard for us to fix this issue quickly.

Have a nice game!

Cheers!

notes.title: Festival aftermath, plans and stuff...
notes.content:
Hello, Horny!

Steam's Next Fest has ended, and boy did we have a blast! Over the course of the last week we've gathered a tremendous audience, resulting in thousands of views, over 1,500 new Wishlists and, what's most important, new fans. The reception "LaHS" gets blows our minds and is something we totally haven't expected. And this can result in only one thing... WE WANT TO MAKE IT EVEN BETTER!

Initially, we have planned to release the game around the end of March, and even with the main mechanics being mostly done and most of the illustrations drawn, we want to move that date and push further. Not only in terms of the game's scope but especially with it's quality. This won't be possible without your support, but this topic will be covered in the next post.

We want to do this not only because we just want to make the game better, but to show you how much we appreciate you, our fans, and the feedback we got from you. During the next months we will be focusing on these three areas:

- Making the game's world more lively
- Making the statistics and grind more pleasant and meaningful
- Adding more "interesting" characters and scenes (illustrations)

Of course there is much more to make, fix and improve, but no point in listing it all now.

As some of you might have already noticed, a small demo update was uploaded today. Initially it was supposed to consist of three new languages of GUI: Chinese, Spanish (made with the help from @Kappa and @ඞNET_FLIX★ from our Discord server ❤) and... well... now we get to the sad part.

Look, we know we're just making a stupid hentai game, with boobas and stuff. This whole gaming industry is all about fun, we get that. And believe me, we've been fighting ourselves if we should be doing anything about it, but we... we're just two terrified people and we simply cannot pretend that nothing wrong is happening...

Downloading the game, on the language select screen, you will be able to see the third language that was supposed to be released today, but when you'll try to select it, you'll see this statement:

[i]Due to the Russian aggression against Ukraine, we decided to stop working on adding Russian language to our game. It is not easy for us, because not all Russians are to blame for the war, and our decision probably will not help too many people anyway. But please take this little gesture of a small, unknown game studio as our attempt to deal with our sense of helplessness in the face of the atrocities of Russian attacks, which are sheer genocide. As Poles, we do what we can to  show solidarity with our Ukrainian brothers and sisters whose blood is shed on their own land today. 

Слава Україні! [/i]

We don't want this space to turn into a political debate, and we're really sorry for everyone who comes to us to take off their minds of the current situation. But living in Poland, sharing our borders with Ukraine and both Russia and Belarus, we just had to do something. We know that we can do jack shit about it. But this is exactly why we wanted to do at least that. A small gesture of solidarity.

See you with the next update, hopefully in the better times!

Inlet Pipe Productions

Hello, Horny people!

We hope you are doing well in those first weeks of 2022. Nonetheless, to make you feel even better, we're coming with yet another update of "Long and Hard... Summer!". Before we jump into the changelog, once again we would like to thank you for your input on what we could improve, comments and reviews. THANK YOU! ❤

This time we're bringing you not one, but two additional days and a new area to visit, so buckle up and hold on tight!

CHANGELOG:

[list]
[*] Two additional days of play
[*] Kaname's quest "Bare Rivals" is possible to finish (thanks to above)
[*] New character's introduction!
[*] New parts of the city unlocked, and with that...
[*] ... new ways of improving your stats, NPCs to meet and a ✨ super-duper arcade minigame 🚀!
[*] Cut-scene fast forwarding 
[*] As always - bug fixes
[/list]

Enjoy your play and don't forget to let us know what you think!

Best,
Inlet Pipe Productions

notes.title: New Year's Update - new content unlocked with v. 0.76
notes.content:
Hello horny people!

This has been a hell of a year for us. I remember when in February we were discussing, depressed and burned out, if we still want to make games and continue this project. We've gone through a lot of similar conversations, meanwhile making a lot of decisions which boil down to that "Long and Hard... Summer!" is a completely different game. And most of all, it's a game we're really proud of.

We are very grateful for every bit of feedback we have received from you, and a (unexpectedly!) large wave of positive comments, followers and new fans only drives us to continue our work. We have a lot of fun stuff prepared for you!

Taking this opportunity, in the coming year, we wish you and ourselves courage in making decisions, strength in pursuing passion and love coming both from and to you. We hope you'll have a great 2022!

Ending with a "big bang" we leave you with a new version 0.76 a.k.a. "New Year's Update".

[b][u]Changelog[/u][/b]:

[list][*]Additional day unlocked[/*][*]New H-Scene (additional day makes Akari-sensei's quest possible to complete)[/*][*]Your first make-up test![/*][*]Improved main menu[/*][*]New "emotional bubbles" during cutscenes[/*][*]"Ending Screen" - our new way of saying "thanks for playing"[/*][*]Bug fixes and text changes[/*][/list]
[b][u]Notice:[/u][u][u][/u][/u][/b]Due to some changes in the project you won't be able to use the previous save files. Sorry for the inconvenience. Use this extra-play to plan ahead for the "Leaking Pipe" quest and get the "Reliability" to level two, *wink* *wink*.

Enjoy your play and don't forget to let us know what you think! See you around!

notes.title: Controller support, new area unlocked and more - V. 0.75 is here!
notes.content:
Hello!

How have you been this past week? We've been quite busy with the development and we're coming with a pack of changes and improvements, woo-hoo! We've considered your suggestions and at least some of you should be happy with the controller support that's been added with this version. Worth noticing is also that another day has been unlocked and now you can play LaHS until Thursday! Below you'll find the list with all changes:

Version 0.75

- Controller support added
- Game can be played until Thursday, Week 1
- Park and train station unlocked
- Text changes and corrections
- Loading time improved
- New sounds added (emotion bubbles, Cleaning activity, eating cutscenes)
- NudeTube app improved
- Bugs fixed (music not playing when loading the game on Monday morning, Week 1; main menu blocker when going back from "start game" and choosing "continue" next; and more)


You're ready to play?
